name: BS170
description: N-channel enhancement-mode small-signal MOSFET in TO-92, 60V / 500mA. Relay/LED drive, level shifting, small servo control, and gate driving for larger MOSFETs. Rds(on) ~1.8 ohm typ (5 ohm max) at Vgs=10V, threshold 0.8-3.0V.

pins.name: D
pins.description: drain; to the load / positive side in a low-side switch

pins.name: G
pins.description: gate; voltage-controlled, high input impedance (center lead)

extra.Rds_on: 1.8 ohm typ, 5 ohm max at Vgs=10V

typical_application: Low-side load switching (relays, LEDs, small motors/servos), logic-to-power level shifting, and gate driving for larger MOSFETs.
gotchas: pinout is D-G-S (pin1=Drain), the REVERSE of the 2N7000 (S-G-D); they are NOT pin-compatible despite similar specs
Vgs absolute max is only +/-20V; ESD-sensitive
not a true logic-level FET: Vgs(th) can reach 3.0V and Rds(on) is rated at Vgs=10V, so 3.3/5V drive gives higher on-resistance than spec
500mA is absolute max; the 350mW package dissipation usually limits continuous current well below that
